emma: Spun a targeted canary for magnet-30b-int4 focusing on long-context prefill + streaming. Observed divergence at token ~11264.
rick: what kind of divergence? jitter, repeat, or soft-quality shift?
emma: clear repeat loops right after a 4096 boundary. fp16 vs int4 identical until 11264 then int4 repeats a 2-token fragment every ~128 tokens.
priya: repeat every 128 tokens suggests an alignment/stride mismatch when we compact k/v entries. Any kvcache logs?
emma: yes: 'kv_write: offset_expected=90112 offset_actual=90111 fix=1'. repeated for several shards.
zhao: that exact pattern sounds like an integer truncation in the int4 packer. We recently changed bitpacking to be little-endian-friendly which altered byte offsets when token count is divisible by the stride.
emma: repro command I ran locally: `python -m repro.longctx --model magnet30b-int4 --prompt tests/long/para_15k.txt --max-tokens 2500 --quant packed4`
priya: metrics? how bad is it?
emma: rolling longset PPL: fp16 9.1, int4 pre-boundary 9.1, int4 post-boundary 14.8. ngram match drops ~7 points.
zhao: try toggling PACK_ENDIAN_SWAP flag at runtime to see if endian handling is the culprit. If that changes behavior it's definitely packing related.
emma: did that; toggling removes the repeat but still slightly degrades overall quality, so packing + phase-scaling interaction likely.
rick: plan: add a pre-pack validation hash computed on raw 32-bit floats per shard and compare to fp16 reference. If mismatch abort packing for that shard and fall back to unpacked int4 storage.
priya: also add unit test for exact boundary: create synthetic keys sized to force offset N*stride and assert pack/unpack roundtrip.
zhao: I'll author the patch (branch kv-int4-pack-bail) and add debug logging for offsets and a per-shard fallback.
ci-bot: kicked CI for branch kv-int4-pack-bail.
emma: canary started with debug flags. initial logs: pre-pack hashes mismatch on shards 5..7 only.
rick: good — narrowed surface. If fallback fixes output we can keep optimization but guard it.
priya: also schedule a short postmortem note in eng-ml/wiki once root cause found, include bitpack pitfalls + RoPE interactions.
emma: tagging @zhao @rick to watch the canary. retention set 72h. will update thread with test PR and canary links.
infra-bot: note: p4d-us-east instances used for canary run driver 535.86, no kernel updates.
emma: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
